name: Honeywell Ensemble
summary: AI digital maintenance service that monitors engine data such as vibration, ITT and pressures to predict component failures; tied to Honeywell's Maintenance Service Plan.
paragraphs: AI digital maintenance service that monitors engine data such as vibration, ITT and pressures to predict component failures; tied to Honeywell's Maintenance Service Plan.
whyItMatters: For business aviation operators on Honeywell engines, it aims to catch problems before they cause unplanned downtime or budget surprises.
